lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary horizontal series of approximately six high-luminance circular clusters is visible across the mid-lateral flank, displaying roughly equidistant spacing and aligning vertically with secondary rows of similar blobs located superiorly and inferiorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a discernible grid-like lattice pattern across the mid-to-posterior visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior margins and low-intensity shadows on the inferior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: The ventral-facing pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots with a discernible gradient of decreasing spot diameter toward the distal and posterior margins of the fin's silhouette.
